topics.name: Command Error and Remediation
topics.purpose: Define structured command failures with exact error class, target/context refs and concise remediation, preserving the runtime UX rule of one actionable remediation line where possible.

semantics.structure_rule: Error includes stable class/code plus machine-readable context.
semantics.remediation_rule: When a deterministic corrective action exists, emit one concise remediation line.
semantics.no_guess_rule: If no deterministic remediation is known, do not invent one.
semantics.security_rule: Errors do not leak restricted target/data/secret metadata.
semantics.cause_rule: Nested/internal causes may be retained for authorized diagnostics while user-facing error remains bounded.
semantics.authority_rule: Error handling never retries by bypassing authorization or enabling hidden capability.

invariants.rule: Executable commands resolve by exact canonical identity and schema, cross one governed dispatcher boundary, and never infer authority from capability presence or parser success.

hard_gates.condition: error only free-form prose with no stable class

references.purpose: Missing capability errors provide deterministic remediation.
